gen-fs-nippo-gf-mozilla-text: Mozilla Text reads sturdy, its lowercase bold-looking and its terminals flaring outward. Over pages of text it settles into a confident hum, while Nippo cuts its heading letters like wire.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Nippo has small letters standing almost capital-sized, strokes that look cut from wire. And Noto Sans Adlam follows with curve endings kept well apart, giving that display voice a clean, open partner.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Noto Sans Armenian gives its round letters a wide, inviting opening. Noto Sans Armenian handles the welcoming, while Nippo does the technical work, its diagonals matching its uprights stroke for stroke.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Modern and clean, Noto Sans Avestan keeps its curve tips from touching and pushes its x-height forward. Nippo, in pencil-like lines that never swell, belongs on big headings.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-noto-sans-bassa-vah: Wire-cut strokes and small letters standing almost capital-sized make Nippo instantly recognizable. But Noto Sans Bassa Vah reads with a dominant midsection and open-jawed c, which keeps paragraphs moving.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-noto-sans-bengali: In Noto Sans Bengali, capitals barely rise above the lowercase. Nippo, meanwhile, has no pinched joints or flared ends, while the body font keeps its letter mouths distinctly open.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-noto-sans-cham: Rounded lowercase forms and generous entry space on every c give Noto Sans Cham its easygoing texture. Nippo gives curves and stems matching weight, which is the real hook.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: A high band of letters with short stalks defines Noto Sans Cherokee. Nippo reads like following a single thread, while the body text leaves a wide gap at each e terminal.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Nippo draws small, nearly capital-sized letters in a rope-thin outline that never varies. Noto Sans Coptic lets the middle zone of the line dominate, leaving its s and c open and uncrowded beside it.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-noto-sans-deseret: Nippo keeps a gentle monotone of line thickness, with small letters standing almost capital-sized. But the real strength sits in Noto Sans Deseret, whose open apertures aid legibility.
